name: Perfect Number
title: B. Perfect Number
legend: We consider a positive integer perfect, if and only if the sum of its digits is exactly 10. Given a positive integer k, your task is to find the k-th smallest perfect positive integer.
input_spec: A single line with a positive integer k (1≤k≤10000).
output_spec: A single number, denoting the k-th smallest perfect integer.
note: The first perfect integer is 19 and the second one is 28.
